name: Unique Logs
description: Logger service that records each distinct message only once per request, suppressing duplicate log entries.
project_description:
Most of the time when dealing with APIs or external systems we end up needing logs for all the faulty data or structure. In run-time at times we end up logging messages for a particular entity/case multiple times since it is inside a function which is invoked multiple times during the request but we want to see the log only once.

 Module here provides a wrapper function to default Logger methods which can be used to reduce number of log messages per request by logging only the unique messages.
